षष्ठी: Ṣaṣṭhī f.: Name of the sixth day of the bright half of the month of Māgha (?). A. Description: important (महातिथि) 3. 218. 49. B. Mythological Event: Skanda married Devasenā on the fifth day of the month of Māgha, and on the sixth day he achieved his objective; hence Ṣaṣṭhī is an important day (षष्ट्यां कृतार्थो ऽभूद् यस्मात् तस्मात् षष्ठी महातिथिः) 3. 218. 49.
षष्टिह्रद: Ṣaṣṭihrada m.: Name of a तीर्थ। There is no gift superior to taking bath in Ṣaṣṭihrada (षष्टिह्रद उपस्पृश्य दानं नान्यद् विशिष्यते) 13. 26. 34.
षण्ड: Ṣaṇḍa m. (pl.): Name of a Janapada. Listed by Saṃjaya among the northern Janapadas (also called Deśas 6. 10. 68) of Bhāratavarṣa (अत ऊर्ध्वं जनपदान् निबोध) 6. 10. 37, 5; (गोविन्दा मन्दकाः षण्डा … ) 6. 10. 42 [see Śaṇḍa].
